Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:
Drawing no. E01/Rev01 (Existing Site Location Plan) Dated 14.01.2026 
Drawing no. E00/Rev01 (Proposed Location Plan and Block Plan) Dated 14.01.2026 
Drawing no. P01/Rev 01 (Proposed Ground Floor Plan) Dated 14.01.2026
Drawing no. P02/Rev01(Proposed First Floor Plan) Dated 14.01.2026
Drawing no. P03/Rev01(Proposed Second Floor Plan and Proposed Main House Roof Plan) Dated 14.01.2026.
Drawing no. P04/Rev00(Proposed Front East Elevation Plan And Proposed Rear West Elevation Plan) Dated 18.11.2025.
Drawing no. P05/Rev00(Proposed Side South Elevation Plan) Dated 18.11.2025 
Drawing no. P06/Rev00(Proposed North Side Elevation Plan) Dated 18.11.2025 
Design, Access and Heritage Statement Dated 18 November 2025
SITE PHOTOGRAPHS Showing (A).7 Camelot Close Street Elevation, (B). 7 Camelot Close: Front Elevation, 
(C).7 Camelot Close: Rear Garden and Rear Elevation, (D).7 Camelot Close: North East boundary, (E). 7 Camelot Close: Southwest boundary, (F). Camelot Close: view from Arthur Road, And  (G). Camelot Close: view from Arthur Road,
Tree Report - BS 5837:2012 Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Constraints Plan, Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan Dated  18 November 2025
Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Tree Replacement - The  T1 Tree identified for removal and replacement on drawing No. P01/Rev00  shall be replaced by a semi-mature tree of the same species and T2 ,T3 ,And T4 Trees shall be retained  and the foundations near these Trees  Roots be Hand Dug and this work be superivised by a Tree Specialist  or as otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority), in the same location at the conclusion of site works, or within the first available planting season, whichever is the sooner. The identified tree shall be maintained, with replacements if necessary, to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Tree Protection - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the BS 5837:2012 Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Constraints Plan, Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection 
Plan, drafted in accordance with the recommendations and guidance set out in BS 5837:2012 dated November 2025 by ATS.  The details and measures as approved shall be retained and maintained, until the completion of all site operations.
Condition : 6 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.
Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE (Party Wall Act) - The applicant is advised to check the requirements of the Party Wall Act 1996 relating to work on an existing wall shared with another property, building on the boundary with a neighbouring property, or excavating near a neighbouring building. Further information is available at the following link: 
https://www.gov.uk/party-walls-building-works
Condition : 8 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved without delay

Condition : 9 - INFORMATIVE
The London Borough of Merton's Environmental Health Service set out that normally the hours for noisy works are:
8am - 6pm on Monday to Friday
8am - 1pm on Saturday
no noisy works on Sundays and Bank Holidays
Further details can be found here: https://www.merton.gov.uk/communities-and-neighbourhoods/noise-nuisance/report-nuisance/building-noise
